courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 都市滯洪池配置
related.transfer: 可遷移「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」與「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；都市滯洪池配置的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" and "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Urban detention-basin planning must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從分流連續到回水與下游影響的分洪道分析；都市滯洪池配置則以以事件體積、出流時間與下游條件配置都市滯洪為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on floodway analysis from flow division to backwater and downstream effects; Urban detention-basin planning centres on planning urban detention through event volume release timing and downstream conditions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「分流控制體與受益範圍」與「集水區與逕流體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到都市滯洪池配置，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「變水頭排空時間機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diversion control volume and effects” and “Catchment and runoff volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Urban detention-basin planning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 土堤壓密與防滲
related.transfer: 可遷移「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」與「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；土堤壓密與防滲的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" and "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Levee compaction and seepage control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從分流連續到回水與下游影響的分洪道分析；土堤壓密與防滲則以區分夯實、地基壓密與防滲失效的土堤推導為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on floodway analysis from flow division to backwater and downstream effects; Levee compaction and seepage control centres on levee reasoning that separates compaction, consolidation and seepage failure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「分流控制體與受益範圍」與「含水量與乾密度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到土堤壓密與防滲，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diversion control volume and effects” and “Moisture and dry density”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Levee compaction and seepage control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 河道分洪工程
history.text: 紅河原分洪道於1962至1968年興建，曼尼托巴官方資料說明低水位時入口門檻和洪水時主河與繞道互動；擴建投資於2005年開始。元朗排洪繞道於2003年開工、2006年完成，把部分逕流帶到錦田河下游，並結合濕地與低流量管理。環保署2017年水理手冊提供管渠、控制構造和演算方法背景。本課僅借用已核對的歷史與功能，未宣稱兩處工程採用所列理想堰或假設糙率。
history.textEn: The original Red River Floodway was constructed from 1962 to 1968; Manitoba describes the low-stage inlet threshold and interaction of river and bypass during floods, with expansion investment beginning in 2005. Yuen Long began construction in 2003 and was completed in 2006, diverting part of runoff toward lower Kam Tin while integrating wetland and low-flow management. EPA’s 2017 hydraulic manual supplies routing and control-method context. Only verified history and function are used; neither project is claimed to employ the lesson’s ideal weir or assumed roughness.

history.title: 河道分洪工程
history.text: 紅河原分洪道施工，形成城市外繞排洪路徑。
history.textEn: Original Red River Floodway construction creates a bypass route around the city.

history.title: 河道分洪工程
history.text: 元朗排洪繞道完成，連結分洪與河道生態配置。
history.textEn: Yuen Long Bypass Floodway is completed with diversion and ecological elements.

history.title: 河道分洪工程
history.text: 環保署發布水理參考手冊，提供流量控制演算背景。
history.textEn: EPA publishes its hydraulic reference manual supporting control and routing methods.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」到「非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" through "Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
